upload.title: Create a synthetic demo report

upload.demoFileLabel: Synthetic demo content (not saved in guest mode)

upload.codeFormat: Use exactly 6 digits. Leave blank for a generated code.
upload.codeReady: Enter this code on My Reports to view the fictional sample report.
upload.privateCodeHelp: Keep this code for the My Reports page. It identifies your report but does not replace account sign-in.
upload.privateNotice: Only the app-generated synthetic text file is saved to private, account-owned Supabase storage. It contains no real health information and is not analyzed. Your code is an identifier, not a substitute for signing in.
upload.demoNotice: Guest demonstration only: no file is uploaded or stored. The code unlocks fictional sample content only.

report.title: My screening report
report.intro: Review each finding, then open the explanation to see what it says, what it does not say, and what to ask a professional.
report.syntheticBanner: Demo example — not a real genetic test result

status.no_variant_identified_in_demo_panel: No relevant variant identified in this demo panel

betaThalassemia.summary: This example finding demonstrates how carrier status may be explained. A carrier finding does not automatically mean the person has the condition.
betaThalassemia.next: Review the inheritance explanation and seek professional interpretation where appropriate.
betaThalassemia.says: A variant associated with beta-thalassemia was reported in one copy of the HBB gene in this fictional panel.
betaThalassemia.notSays: It does not say the person has beta-thalassemia, and it does not say anything about a future child on its own.
betaThalassemia.uncertainty: Couple-level implications depend on whether a biological partner has a relevant HBB finding.
questions: Does this carrier finding affect my own health?
Should my partner be offered screening for the same gene?

sickleCell.summary: No relevant variant was identified in the fictional demonstration panel. This does not rule out every possible genetic risk.
sickleCell.next: No action is suggested by this demonstration result alone.
sickleCell.says: The variants tested for sickle cell disease in this fictional panel were not found.
sickleCell.notSays: It does not rule out every possible variant or every inherited condition.
sickleCell.uncertainty: Panels test selected variants only. Untested variants are not covered.
questions: Which variants did the panel include?
Is my family background relevant to what was tested?

sma.summary: This example finding cannot establish a definitive conclusion. A qualified genetics professional should review the result and explain whether further assessment is appropriate.
sma.next: Ask a qualified genetics professional to review this result.
sma.says: The test could not reach a clear conclusion about SMN1 carrier status.
sma.notSays: It does not say the person is a carrier, and it does not say they are not a carrier.
sma.uncertainty: SMA screening has technical limitations and may leave residual risk.
questions: What does residual risk mean for me?

cysticFibrosis.summary: This fictional panel does not include a result for this condition. No conclusion about carrier status should be drawn.
cysticFibrosis.next: Ask whether screening for this condition is relevant to you.
cysticFibrosis.says: Cystic fibrosis was not included in this demonstration panel.
cysticFibrosis.notSays: It does not say anything about CFTR carrier status.
cysticFibrosis.uncertainty: Carrier status for this condition is unknown.
questions: Should cystic fibrosis screening be considered for me?

report.professional: A qualified genetics professional can confirm what a finding means for you and whether further assessment is appropriate.
report.questionsLabel: Questions you could ask a counsellor
report.disclaimer: This explanation is educational and based on a demo example. It is not a clinical interpretation or diagnosis.
report.upload: The selected file is not uploaded, opened, or stored. This page displays fictional sample data only and performs no clinical genetic analysis.

reportAccess.prototypeNotice: Prototype only: this is a front-end demonstration. The code is not server-verified and unlocks fictional sample data only.
reportAccess.noCode: No report code has been created for this visit yet.
reportAccess.invalidCode: That code does not match the code created on Overview.

partner.title: Partner Sharing
partner.intro: Explore how consent-based sharing could work. This prototype does not connect partner accounts or share uploaded reports.
partner.syntheticNote: Demo invitation — no message will be sent.
partner.prototypeNotice: Prototype only: invitations, permissions, and comparisons are simulated in this browser session. They do not connect accounts or access uploaded reports. Use Privacy to manage your actual account consent.

sharingChoice.heading: Sharing Is Your Choice
sharingChoice.intro: An invitation does not automatically provide access to personal screening results. Each individual should understand and authorize the information they choose to share.
sharingChoice.independent: Each person grants their own permissions. Your partner's choices are separate from yours.
sharingChoice.diagramAlt: Illustration of consent before information is shared between parties.

invite.heading: Invitation
invite.pending: Invitation {{code}} is waiting for your partner.

enter.heading: Enter a partner code
enter.body: Enter a demo invitation code to simulate a connection. Codes are not verified and do not provide access to real accounts or reports.
enter.invalid: Enter a code in the format RAF-INV-ABCD using supported characters.
enter.unavailable: Cancel or reset the current demonstration before entering another code.
enter.connected: This code was accepted in the local demonstration. No partner account was contacted.

consent.heading: What you share
consent.intro: Each category is a separate permission. Nothing is shared until you switch it on.
consent.needsPartner: Connect a partner before choosing what to share.

carrierFindings.title: Selected carrier findings
carrierFindings.body: Carrier findings from your report, such as the gene and condition. Used for the educational comparison.

reportInfo.title: Relevant report information
reportInfo.body: Inconclusive findings that may need professional review. Not your full report.

referralInfo.title: Counselling referral information
referralInfo.body: Whether you have requested counselling, so your partner can join if you both agree.

consent.revokeBody: Your partner will lose access from now on. Revoking cannot undo information they have already viewed or kept.
consent.notShared: Never shared: your full report, results with no relevant variant, untested conditions and your profile details.

partnerSide.heading: Your partner's sharing (demo)
partnerSide.body: Your partner controls their own permissions. In this demo, use the button below to show what happens when they share carrier findings.
partnerSide.shared: Your partner shared selected carrier findings.
partnerSide.notShared: Your partner has not shared any findings.

risk.heading: Shared risk overview
risk.noScore: RAFEEQ never shows a compatibility score or a recommendation about marriage.
risk.noPartner: Partner information has not been shared. Couple-level risk cannot be assessed from your individual findings alone.
risk.pending: Your partner has not completed the consent process. No partner findings have been shared.
risk.noSharedFindings: Your accounts are connected, but no relevant genetic findings have been authorised for this educational comparison.
risk.insufficient: The available information is not sufficient for a reliable educational conclusion. A qualified genetics professional should review the findings.
risk.exampleIntro: Both of you shared a carrier finding in the same gene ({{genes}}) for a condition that typically follows autosomal recessive inheritance. In this specific demo example, the typical model for each pregnancy is:

outcomes.label: chance of a child who is a carrier
chance of a child who inherits neither familial variant

risk.exampleCaveat: This is an inheritance example for one gene, not a universal couple-level risk. Each pregnancy is independent. A qualified genetics professional should confirm whether this applies to you.

partner.resetDone: The partner demonstration was reset. A reset event stays in the history.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Notifications never include genetic findings in the preview. Open one to see details in your private dashboard.

items.reportReady: Your demonstration screening report is ready to review.
items.inconclusiveExplained: You have an educational explanation available for an inconclusive finding.
items.invitePending: Your partner invitation is awaiting a response.
items.referralChanged: Your demonstration referral status has changed.

settingsPage.title: Profile and settings
settingsPage.intro: Manage display, notifications, and privacy. Demo sessions show synthetic profile details; signed-in accounts use their own profile.
settingsPage.profileUpdateError: Your display name could not be saved. Please try again.
settingsPage.essentialNote: Always on. These tell you when sharing changes.
settingsPage.privacyBody: Manage account consent in Privacy. Partner Sharing is a separate prototype demonstration.
settingsPage.securityBody: Supabase accounts use email and password. Demo profiles continue to use separate temporary sessions.
settingsPage.signOutBody: Signs out of your Supabase account or ends the demonstration session on this device.
settingsPage.deleteProfileBody: This removes only your profile record. It does not delete your sign-in account or other app data.
settingsPage.deleteProfileConfirm: Delete your profile record? Your Supabase sign-in account and other data will remain.
settingsPage.profileDeleted: Your profile record was deleted. Your sign-in account remains active.
settingsPage.profileNotFound: No profile record was found for this account.
settingsPage.profileDeleteError: Your profile could not be deleted. Please try again.
